title: Surreal Lakeside Vortex
description: A vibrant surreal landscape depicts a small red house on a pebbled shore beside a bright blue lake. A lone figure sits in a wooden rowboat on the water, which features colorful concentric ripples, while a swirling cosmic vortex of circles and orbs dominates the sky above green mountains.
prompt: Surreal vibrant landscape with a small red house on a dark pebble shore next to a bright blue lake. A person sits alone in a wooden rowboat creating colorful circular ripples on the water. Dramatic swirling cosmic vortex made of overlapping purple, orange, green and yellow circles and rings fills the sky above green and black mountains under a bright blue sky with multiple glowing yellow orbs.
